rules.ambiguous: same_name_in_area OR state_name OR common_word OR always_ambiguous. An ambiguous name resolves only with a state qualifier ("Marion, Ill.") or a co-occurring county alias that picks one candidate; a feed's state never resolves it.
rules.requiresState: ambiguous OR namesakes_elsewhere (the name exists outside the 68 counties, per the national 2025 Gazetteer place and county files), unless alias-review.json lists the name as distinctive. A requiresState name that is not ambiguous also resolves from the feed's own state.
rules.distinctive: an override can clear requiresState for a name with namesakes elsewhere; it can never clear ambiguous.

sources.namesakes: census/2025_namesakes.txt, derived by scripts/extract-census.js from 2025_Gaz_place_national.txt and 2025_Gaz_counties_national.txt
